sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a mode selector (three tabs: bar-magnet
pair, magnet-vs-wire, two parallel wires). In each mode, two
draggable objects with orientation controls (flip N/S for magnets,
reverse current arrow for wires). A dashed interaction arrow between
them shows attract (green, →←) or repel (red, ←→), or "none" (grey).
Experiment: given a target label ("attract") in each mode, set
orientations to produce it. Evaluate: interaction label hidden;
student predicts behavior first, then reveal to check. Wrinkle:
purely qualitative — no numeric force computed.
